tactile_preprocessing.baseline_estimator: per-taxel median on an initial train-only prefix
tactile_preprocessing.noise_estimator: 1.482602218505602 times per-taxel median absolute deviation on the same prefix
tactile_preprocessing.prediction_target: baseline-corrected tactile feature increment over the selected horizon

design.horizon_selection_rule: minimum state-gated full-covariance calibration NLL per dimension; lower horizon breaks exact ties
design.action_exposure: sum of executed robot transition primitives from state frame through prediction horizon
design.causal_history: mean robot transition primitives in windows ending immediately before the state frame
design.state_gate: train-normalized current log dynamic tactile activity multiplied with horizon action exposure

statistical_scope: Single-episode source competence diagnostic only. Frames are temporally dependent observations nested within one episode and are not independent experimental units. Horizon and hyperparameters are selected on the chronological calibration block; the final test block remains untouched until one evaluation.
claim_boundary: This protocol may qualify baseline-corrected source tactile-innovation prediction and dependence-preserving uncertainty. It cannot establish physical-parameter identifiability, metric geometry, cross-action transport, target benefit, independent-object generalization, Causal4D decision value, safety, or an ICRA paper claim.
